questions.question: What is CSS?
questions.answer: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to style and layout web pages. It controls colors, fonts, spacing, and positioning.

questions.question: What are the three ways to apply CSS?
questions.answer: Inline (style attribute), internal (<style> tag), and external (separate .css file). External stylesheets are preferred.

questions.question: What is a CSS selector?
questions.answer: A CSS selector targets HTML elements to apply styles. Types include element, class, ID, attribute, and pseudo-selectors.

questions.question: What is the difference between class and ID selectors?
questions.answer: Class selectors (.) can be used multiple times. ID selectors (#) should be unique. IDs have higher specificity.

questions.question: What is CSS specificity?
questions.answer: Specificity determines which CSS rule applies when multiple rules target the same element. ID > class > element.

questions.question: What is the CSS cascade?
questions.answer: The cascade determines which styles apply when multiple rules target the same element. Later rules override earlier ones.

questions.question: What is the !important flag?
questions.answer: !important increases specificity and overrides other styles. It should be used sparingly as it makes debugging harder.

questions.question: What is the CSS box model?
questions.answer: The box model consists of content, padding, border, and margin. It determines the total size of an element.

questions.question: What is the difference between margin and padding?
questions.answer: Padding is inside the border, margin is outside. Padding affects the element's content area, margin affects spacing between elements.

questions.question: What is the difference between block and inline elements?
questions.answer: Block elements take full width and start on new lines. Inline elements only take necessary width and flow within text.

questions.question: What is the display property?
questions.answer: The display property controls how an element is rendered. Common values: block, inline, inline-block, flex, grid, none.

questions.question: What is the position property?
questions.answer: The position property controls element positioning. Values: static (default), relative, absolute, fixed, sticky.

questions.question: What is the difference between relative and absolute positioning?
questions.answer: Relative positioning is relative to the element's normal position. Absolute positioning is relative to the nearest positioned ancestor.

questions.question: What is fixed positioning?
questions.answer: Fixed positioning removes an element from the document flow and positions it relative to the viewport. It stays in place when scrolling.

questions.question: What is sticky positioning?
questions.answer: Sticky positioning is a hybrid of relative and fixed. It's relative until it reaches a scroll position, then becomes fixed.

questions.question: What is the z-index property?
questions.answer: The z-index property controls the stacking order of positioned elements. Higher values appear on top.

questions.question: What is the float property?
questions.answer: The float property removes an element from the document flow and positions it to the left or right. It's used for text wrapping.

questions.question: What is the clear property?
questions.answer: The clear property prevents elements from floating beside floated elements. Values: left, right, both.

questions.question: What is the overflow property?
questions.answer: The overflow property controls what happens when content overflows. Values: visible, hidden, scroll, auto.

questions.question: What is the visibility property?
questions.answer: The visibility property hides elements while preserving space. Values: visible, hidden, collapse.

questions.question: What is the opacity property?
questions.answer: The opacity property controls transparency. Values: 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).

questions.question: What is the background property?
questions.answer: The background property sets background color, image, or gradient. It's a shorthand for multiple background properties.

questions.question: What is the background-image property?
questions.answer: The background-image property sets a background image. It uses url() to specify the image path.

questions.question: What is the background-size property?
questions.answer: The background-size property controls background image size. Values: cover, contain, or specific dimensions.

questions.question: What is the background-position property?
questions.answer: The background-position property controls background image position. Values: keywords (top, left, etc.) or coordinates.

questions.question: What is the background-repeat property?
questions.answer: The background-repeat property controls background image repetition. Values: repeat, repeat-x, repeat-y, no-repeat.

questions.question: What is the background-attachment property?
questions.answer: The background-attachment property controls if background scrolls. Values: scroll, fixed.

questions.question: What is the color property?
questions.answer: The color property sets text color. It accepts color names, hex codes, RGB, or HSL values.

questions.question: What is the font-family property?
questions.answer: The font-family property sets the typeface. It accepts multiple fonts as fallbacks.

questions.question: What is the font-size property?
questions.answer: The font-size property sets text size. Units: px, em, rem, %, etc.

questions.question: What is the difference between em and rem?
questions.answer: em is relative to parent font size. rem is relative to root font size. rem is more predictable.

questions.question: What is the font-weight property?
questions.answer: The font-weight property sets text boldness. Values: normal, bold, or 100-900.

questions.question: What is the font-style property?
questions.answer: The font-style property sets text style. Values: normal, italic, oblique.

questions.question: What is the text-align property?
questions.answer: The text-align property aligns text. Values: left, right, center, justify.

questions.question: What is the text-decoration property?
questions.answer: The text-decoration property adds decorations to text. Values: none, underline, overline, line-through.

questions.question: What is the text-transform property?
questions.answer: The text-transform property changes text case. Values: uppercase, lowercase, capitalize.

questions.question: What is the line-height property?
questions.answer: The line-height property sets space between lines. Values: number, length, or percentage.

questions.question: What is the letter-spacing property?
questions.answer: The letter-spacing property sets space between letters. Values: normal or length.

questions.question: What is the word-spacing property?
questions.answer: The word-spacing property sets space between words. Values: normal or length.

questions.question: What is the text-shadow property?
questions.answer: The text-shadow property adds shadow to text. Syntax: offset-x offset-y blur-radius color.

questions.question: What is the white-space property?
questions.answer: The white-space property controls whitespace handling. Values: normal, nowrap, pre, pre-wrap.

questions.question: What is the word-wrap property?
questions.answer: The word-wrap property allows breaking long words. Values: normal, break-word.

questions.question: What is the border property?
questions.answer: The border property sets border style, width, and color. Shorthand for border-width, border-style, border-color.

questions.question: What is the border-radius property?
questions.answer: The border-radius property rounds corners. Values: length or percentage.

questions.question: What is the box-shadow property?
questions.answer: The box-shadow property adds shadow to elements. Syntax: offset-x offset-y blur-radius spread-radius color.

questions.question: What is the outline property?
questions.answer: The outline property adds an outline outside the border. It doesn't affect layout.

questions.question: What is the difference between border and outline?
questions.answer: Border is inside the box model. Outline is outside and doesn't affect layout.

questions.question: What is the width property?
questions.answer: The width property sets element width. Values: auto, length, or percentage.

questions.question: What is the height property?
questions.answer: The height property sets element height. Values: auto, length, or percentage.

questions.question: What is the max-width property?
questions.answer: The max-width property sets maximum width. It prevents elements from exceeding a certain width.

questions.question: What is the min-width property?
questions.answer: The min-width property sets minimum width. It prevents elements from being narrower than a certain width.

questions.question: What is the max-height property?
questions.answer: The max-height property sets maximum height. It prevents elements from exceeding a certain height.

questions.question: What is the min-height property?
questions.answer: The min-height property sets minimum height. It prevents elements from being shorter than a certain height.

questions.question: What is the transform property?
questions.answer: The transform property applies 2D or 3D transformations. Values: translate, rotate, scale, skew.

questions.question: What is the transition property?
questions.answer: The transition property animates property changes. Syntax: property duration timing-function delay.

questions.question: What is the animation property?
questions.answer: The animation property applies animations. It references @keyframes and specifies duration and timing.

questions.question: What is @keyframes?
questions.answer: @keyframes defines animation steps. It specifies styles at different percentages (0%, 50%, 100%).

questions.question: What is the filter property?
questions.answer: The filter property applies graphical effects. Values: blur, brightness, contrast, grayscale, etc.

questions.question: What is the cursor property?
questions.answer: The cursor property changes the mouse cursor. Values: pointer, hand, text, wait, etc.

questions.question: What is the list-style property?
questions.answer: The list-style property styles lists. It controls marker type, position, and image.

questions.question: What is the list-style-type property?
questions.answer: The list-style-type property sets marker type. Values: disc, circle, square, decimal, etc.

questions.question: What is the list-style-position property?
questions.answer: The list-style-position property sets marker position. Values: inside, outside.

questions.question: What is the list-style-image property?
questions.answer: The list-style-image property uses custom marker image. It uses url() to specify the image.

questions.question: What is the table-layout property?
questions.answer: The table-layout property controls table layout algorithm. Values: auto, fixed.

questions.question: What is the border-collapse property?
questions.answer: The border-collapse property merges table borders. Values: collapse, separate.

questions.question: What is the border-spacing property?
questions.answer: The border-spacing property sets space between table cells. It works with border-collapse: separate.

questions.question: What is the vertical-align property?
questions.answer: The vertical-align property aligns inline elements vertically. Values: top, middle, bottom, baseline.

questions.question: What is the text-indent property?
questions.answer: The text-indent property indents the first line of text. Values: length or percentage.

questions.question: What is the text-overflow property?
questions.answer: The text-overflow property handles overflowing text. Values: clip, ellipsis.

questions.question: What is the clip property?
questions.answer: The clip property clips content. It's deprecated in favor of clip-path.

questions.question: What is the clip-path property?
questions.answer: The clip-path property clips elements to a shape. Values: polygon, circle, ellipse, inset.

questions.question: What is the mask property?
questions.answer: The mask property applies a mask image. It hides parts of an element based on the mask.

questions.question: What is the pointer-events property?
questions.answer: The pointer-events property controls mouse interactions. Values: auto, none.

questions.question: What is the user-select property?
questions.answer: The user-select property controls text selection. Values: auto, none, text, all.

questions.question: What is the resize property?
questions.answer: The resize property allows resizing elements. Values: none, both, horizontal, vertical.

questions.question: What is the appearance property?
questions.answer: The appearance property removes default styling. Values: none, auto.

questions.question: What is the caret-color property?
questions.answer: The caret-color property sets the cursor color in inputs. Values: color or auto.

questions.question: What is the accent-color property?
questions.answer: The accent-color property sets accent color for form elements. It affects checkboxes, radio buttons, etc.

questions.question: What is the scroll-behavior property?
questions.answer: The scroll-behavior property controls smooth scrolling. Values: auto, smooth.

questions.question: What is the scroll-snap-type property?
questions.answer: The scroll-snap-type property enables scroll snapping. Values: none, x, y, both.

questions.question: What is the scroll-snap-align property?
questions.answer: The scroll-snap-align property aligns elements in scroll snap. Values: none, start, center, end.

questions.question: What is the scroll-margin property?
questions.answer: The scroll-margin property sets margin for scroll snapping. It affects snap alignment.

questions.question: What is the scroll-padding property?
questions.answer: The scroll-padding property sets padding for scroll snapping. It affects the snap area.

questions.question: What is the overscroll-behavior property?
questions.answer: The overscroll-behavior property controls overscroll effects. Values: auto, contain, none.

questions.question: What is the touch-action property?
questions.answer: The touch-action property controls touch gestures. Values: auto, none, manipulation.

questions.question: What is the will-change property?
questions.answer: The will-change property hints at upcoming animations. It optimizes performance for changes.

questions.question: What is the contain property?
questions.answer: The contain property limits rendering scope. It improves performance for complex layouts.

questions.question: What is the content-visibility property?
questions.answer: The content-visibility property skips rendering off-screen content. It improves performance.

questions.question: What is the content-size property?
questions.answer: The content-size property hints at element size. It helps with layout calculations.

questions.question: What is the aspect-ratio property?
questions.answer: The aspect-ratio property maintains element aspect ratio. Values: width / height.

questions.question: What is the object-fit property?
questions.answer: The object-fit property controls how images fit in containers. Values: fill, contain, cover, scale-down.

questions.question: What is the object-position property?
questions.answer: The object-position property positions images in containers. Values: keywords or coordinates.

questions.question: What is the image-rendering property?
questions.answer: The image-rendering property controls image quality. Values: auto, crisp-edges, pixelated.

questions.question: What is the image-orientation property?
questions.answer: The image-orientation property rotates images. Values: from-image, angle.

questions.question: What is the backdrop-filter property?
questions.answer: The backdrop-filter property applies effects behind elements. Values: blur, brightness, contrast, etc.

questions.question: What is the mix-blend-mode property?
questions.answer: The mix-blend-mode property blends elements. Values: multiply, screen, overlay, etc.

questions.question: What is the background-blend-mode property?
questions.answer: The background-blend-mode property blends backgrounds. Values: multiply, screen, overlay, etc.

questions.question: What is the isolation property?
questions.answer: The isolation property creates stacking context. It affects how blend modes work.

questions.question: What is the paint-order property?
questions.answer: The paint-order property controls SVG paint order. Values: normal, stroke, fill, markers.

questions.question: What is the difference between CSS and SCSS?
questions.answer: SCSS is a CSS preprocessor with variables, nesting, and functions. It compiles to CSS.
